PD Arrays · Advanced

Propulsion Block

A specialised order-block refinement described in some ICT education. Secondary definitions describe an order-block reaction and a subsequent close through a reference candle level, but the exact sequence differs by source.

Open interactive ICT Academy →Official ICT channel ↗Official playlists ↗

How to identify and use this concept

  1. First identify a valid order block created by displacement.
  2. Require a revisit and define the midpoint or mean-threshold rule in advance.
  3. Mark the reaction candle and the exact close required by the chosen source.
  4. Record invalidation through the opposite side of the block.
Use only as an advanced refinement after understanding basic Order Blocks and fixing written rules.

Common mistakes and limitations

Using the label for any reaction inside an OB; changing midpoint/close criteria after the outcome; assuming the pattern has independent edge.
